text.en:
Section 3 of Republic Act No. 720, as amended, is hereby further amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 3. In furtherance of this policy, the Monetary Board of the Central Bank of the Philippines shall
formulate the necessary rules and regulations governing the establishment and operation of Rural Banks for
the purpose of providing adequate credit facilities to farmers or merchants, or to cooperatives of such farmers
or merchants and, in general, to the people of the rural communities, and to supervise the operation of such
